id: does not push again when nothing changed
reason: Advances fake time by exactly PUSH_INTERVAL_MS (6h) past the first push. Whenever the test happens to run inside the ~6h window before UTC midnight, that advance crosses the day boundary, the push's dedupe key (which includes today's date) changes, and the interval fires a second push — failing an assertion the test's own timing can't control. Pre-existing, unrelated to PR #1321's test-quality-coach diff.
